precedence.title: How a markup is chosen
precedence.body: Exactly one rule applies per request. Rules never add up: the most specific level wins.
precedence.models: Within the same level, an exact model beats a pattern, a longer pattern beats a shorter one, and both beat all models. Set 0 % on a project to exempt it from its company markup.
precedence.billing: The markup goes on top of the price the model group bills, which is the provider's purchase cost unless the group uses an average or custom price. Spend, budgets, and the usage PDF show the sale price. Purchase cost and margin stay with the View margins permission and are never shown to company users.
